'''Vodo-Siosk Baas's heavy courier''' was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] to travel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with [[Tott Doneeta]], [[Nomi Sunrider]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], [[Dace Diath]], [[Shoaneb Culu]], [[Qrrrl Toq]], and [[Sylvar]], shortly before the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] assault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="The Sith War 2" />

*[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]
